{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the total number of rows
total_rows = len(df)

# Check the number of unique patient_id values
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Check if the number of rows matches the number of unique patients
# If not, it means some patients have multiple entries
if total_rows == unique_patients:
    print("Each patient has exactly one entry.")
else:
    print(f"There are {total_rows} rows but only {unique_patients} unique patients. Some patients have multiple entries.")

# Count how many patients have multiple entries
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
num_multiple_entries = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Display the number of unique patients and the number of multiple entries
unique_patients, num_multiple_entries"}
